mailbox_activity_detail_rejected: The server rejected the operation or it ran out of retries. Check the account and the target folder.
mailbox_activity_detail_server_rejected: The server rejected the operation. Check the account and the target folder.
mailbox_activity_detail_unconfirmed: No final confirmation was received. Check the target folder first.
mailbox_activity_error_load: Couldn't load sync activity. Try again.
mailbox_activity_error_resolve: The result wasn't confirmed. Refresh to check before retrying again.
mailbox_activity_operation_unsupported: Operation not supported by this version
mailbox_activity_state_unsupported: State not supported by this version
mailbox_attachment_not_cached: This attachment's contents aren't in the local cache.
mailbox_attachment_save_failed: Saving didn't finish; existing files were left unchanged.
mailbox_batch_report_hint: Server sync results are on the Sync activity page.
mailbox_delete_policy_flag: Marked as deleted and handled by the server under the mail protocol; this app can't undo it.
mailbox_delete_policy_note: The actual behavior follows the folder mapping at the time the background service queues it. If the server is offline, the operation waits to sync.
mailbox_document_error_denied: This frontend isn't authorized to read this message's formatting.
mailbox_document_error_failed: Couldn't prepare the HTML version, so plain text is shown.
mailbox_document_error_not_found: This message is no longer in the local cache.
mailbox_document_error_offline: The background service is unavailable, so the message is shown as plain text.
mailbox_document_no_html: No HTML version is cached, so plain text is shown.
mailbox_document_truncated: The cached body is incomplete (anything past 256 KiB wasn't saved).
mailbox_error_connection_changed: The connection changed, so the remaining operations weren't submitted.
mailbox_error_cross_account: Messages can't be moved across accounts; select them one account at a time.
mailbox_error_denied: This frontend isn't authorized to do that.
mailbox_error_detail: Can't load the message body right now. Try again later.
mailbox_error_detail_offline: This message's body wasn't loaded this session; you can view it once the background service is back.
mailbox_error_folders: Folder information is unavailable right now. Refresh.
mailbox_error_index: Can't confirm whether the search index is complete right now.
mailbox_error_intent_no_folder: This older notification has no folder information; choose the message from the account list.
mailbox_error_locate: Couldn't find this message; look for it in the inbox.
mailbox_error_no_archive: {account} has no archive folder available; use “Move” to choose a destination.
mailbox_error_not_found: This message is no longer in the local cache. Refresh.
mailbox_error_offline: The background service is unavailable; content already loaded is still viewable.
mailbox_error_receipt_identity: The background service's receipt is missing message identities. Refresh to check.
mailbox_error_receipt_invalid: The background service returned an invalid receipt. Refresh to check.
mailbox_error_receipt_missing: Some messages changed or aren't available locally. Refresh to check.
mailbox_error_receipt_partial: Some messages weren't confirmed. Refresh to check.
mailbox_error_remote_fetch: Can't download this message from the server right now. Try again later.
mailbox_error_remote_gone: This message is no longer on the server; it may have been moved or deleted.
mailbox_error_remote_offline: This message is still on the server; it can be downloaded once the background service is back.
mailbox_error_rows: Can't load the message list right now. Try again.
mailbox_error_server_search: Server search is unavailable: the background service doesn't support it yet, or the server didn't respond.
mailbox_error_server_search_partial: Server search didn't finish for some accounts, so results may be incomplete.
mailbox_error_submit_unconfirmed: Some submissions weren't confirmed. Refresh or check Sync activity first; don't just repeat the move.
mailbox_error_sync: The background service couldn't check for new mail right away; the local list was refreshed.
mailbox_error_thread: Couldn't load the full conversation. Close it and open it again.
mailbox_link_mailto_lead: A new draft opens in this window; nothing is sent automatically.
mailbox_link_other_policy: {product} only hands http/https links to the browser and never opens other schemes.
mailbox_move_target_empty: This account has no other folders available right now.
mailbox_navigation_unsaved_draft: Deal with the unsaved draft first.
mailbox_reading_error_invalid: Not saved: enter a full email address (a@b.c) or a domain (b.c).
mailbox_reading_error_read_denied: This frontend isn't authorized to read the reading policy.
mailbox_reading_error_read_failed: Can't read the reading policy right now.
mailbox_reading_error_write_failed: Not saved: the reading policy file is unavailable or the background service is offline.
mailbox_reading_intro: Remote images, styles and fonts in mail don't load by default; scripts, forms and app APIs are never available in message bodies. These settings are kept by the background service, so they apply in any frontend.
mailbox_reading_not_persisted: The background service's reading policy file is unavailable, so the default (block) applies. Changes are refused until the file is repaired.
mailbox_reading_remote_hint: When blocked, you can choose “Load for this message” on any message; it only lasts for this session.
mailbox_reading_trusted_empty: The list is empty. Clicking “Always allow” on a message with blocked content also adds the sender here.
mailbox_reading_trusted_hint: Mail from these addresses or domains loads remote images. Only full addresses or exact domains match: trusting example.com doesn't allow news.example.com.
mailbox_remote_allowed_address: Remote content from {address} loaded because the address is trusted.
mailbox_remote_allowed_all: Remote content loaded because Reading & Privacy allows it for all mail.
mailbox_remote_allowed_domain: Remote content from the {domain} domain loaded because the domain is trusted.
mailbox_remote_allowed_once: Remote content loaded for this message (this time only, not remembered).
mailbox_remote_blocked_one: Blocked {count} remote resource (images etc.); no request was sent to any server.
mailbox_remote_blocked_other: Blocked {count} remote resources (images etc.); no request was sent to any server.
mailbox_remote_cid_missing_one: {count} embedded image isn't in the local cache.
mailbox_remote_cid_missing_other: {count} embedded images aren't in the local cache.
mailbox_remote_policy_denied: This frontend isn't authorized to change the reading policy.
mailbox_remote_policy_failed: Couldn't save the reading policy. Try again later.
mailbox_remote_trust_address_title: Adds the sender to the trusted list in Reading & Privacy; future mail from this address will request remote resources
mailbox_sync_background: Sync started and is still running in the background.
mailbox_thread_capped: This conversation is long; use search to narrow it down.
mailbox_thread_load_more: Load more messages in this conversation
mailbox_thread_unindexed_body: This message isn't in the conversation index yet, so only this message can be shown for now.
